news.title: EXCLUSIVE: Arsenal revive interest in Atletico Madrid star Baena
news.lede: Arsenal are targeting a potential January transfer for Atletico Madrid’s World Cup-winning winger Alex Baena, FootballTransfers can reveal. The Gunners were known to be seeking an attacking midfielder in the previous transfer window, but while they were ready to splash out on Real Madrid’s Vinicius Junior, they ultimately only added Christos Tzolis to Mikel Arteta’s ranks. Despite a strong start to their Premier League defence and Champions League challenge, Arsenal are still striving to improve their squad and have identified Baena as a potential January signing, sources in Spain have told FootballTransfers. Arsenal previously targeted Baena back in 2024 before he left Villarreal for Atleti, and now the Gunners are revisiting a potential move.

news.title: CommBank Junior Matildas Squad Update: 22nd October 2026
news.lede: CommBank Junior Matildas goalkeeper Alyse Oppedisano has sustained an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury during training and will take no further part in the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup. With the continued support of Football Australia and Sydney FC, Oppedisano will depart camp to commence her rehabilitation, with her focus now turning to the road ahead. We wish Alyse all the very best in her recovery. "I’m disappointed that my tournament has come to an end, but I’m proud to have been part of this group.

news.title: World Cup star receives La Liga offer just FOUR MONTHS into Premier League career
news.lede: The 21-year-old Swiss schemer joined Villa from SC Freiburg for €60M back in July, signing a contract at Villa Park until June 2031. He's hit the ground running as a perfect Premier League style box-to-box midfielder, registering three goals and two assists across all competitions. The links to Spain are in their early stages, as per reports from Football Insider, with the player himself currently happy working with Unai Emery after rejecting other offers after the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Barca and Real Madrid will continue to monitor his progress and the situation could be revisited if Villa fail to qualify for the UEFA Champions League in 2027.
